reddit.title: Enhancements to Colony Music in Provincia
reddit.body: We've improved the way music transitions in Provincia to create a smoother experience. Instead of hard cuts, our new system uses a long equal-power crossfade to seamlessly blend tracks. This means you'll enjoy a more immersive atmosphere as day turns to night or during combat. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
